verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs describe a built-in Jira UI that lets developers view/manage Jira issues directly in Bitbucket, auto-update issue status via commit messages, and open Jira tickets from the PR screen — directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the Jira UI experience and detail on scope of issue management (e.g., editing fields vs just viewing/transitioning).
